title: Decision Table — Which Class H Preferred Stock Shares Count toward the Holding Ceiling, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
Which shares of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding count toward the holding ceiling rests on the holding's reinvestment record, because the ceiling governs what a member buys.

## Decision table

| Reinvested dividend entry dated within the last 4 whole months | Reinvested dividend entries in all | Shares counted toward the ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 8 or more | The holding's purchases less its retirements — all reinvested dividend shares left out |
| Yes | Fewer than 8 | All shares less the holding's latest reinvested dividend |
| No | Any number | Every share: purchases plus reinvested dividends less retirements |

For a holding with a reinvested dividend entry dated within the last 4 whole months and at least 8 reinvested dividend entries in all, the shares counted are its purchases less its retirements, all reinvested dividend shares left out; for a holding with a reinvested dividend entry dated within the last 4 whole months but fewer than 8 entries in all, the shares counted leave out only its latest reinvested dividend; for any other holding every share counts.

The months are whole calendar months counted back from today; the latest reinvested dividend is the one with the latest effective date on the holding.

## Worked lines (hypothetical holding: purchases 1,020,000.00, reinvested dividends 12,500.00 with the latest 3,100.00, retirements 0.00)

| Reinvestment record | Shares counted |
|---|---|
| Latest dividend 2 months ago; 10 entries in all | 1,020,000.00 |
| Latest dividend 2 months ago; 5 entries in all | 1,032,500.00 less 3,100.00 gives 1,029,400.00 |
| Latest dividend 6 months ago; 10 entries in all | 1,032,500.00 |
| Latest dividend 2 months ago; exactly 8 entries | 1,020,000.00 — 8 counts as at least 8 |
